title: Why English Is Losing Its Grip On The Internet
hook: The web was built in English, and English is now losing it.
closing: Search only in English and you miss nearly half the internet, and the people behind it.
question: Which language do you browse in?

segments.say: By 2005, English had fallen to 45 percent of web pages. People in other countries were coming online.
In ten years, Arabic content grew nearly nine times faster than English. The web stopped being an English club.
English still leads with 55 percent of websites. That sounds dominant, but nearly half the web speaks something else.
